BiblicalUsage: Irham-Melach is the city of salt, named among the cities of Judah in the wilderness. In Joshua 15:62 it stands in the list with Nibshan and Engedi, in the wilderness toward the Salt Sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the city of salt is remembered for where it stood: in the wilderness of Judah, near the sea that nothing lives in.
